changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO audit_module_catalog(source_system,module_key,module_name,parent_module_key,owner,enabled,order_value,version,updated_at) VALUES ('platform','governance.indicator','数据指标','governance','platform',true,5000,'indicator-analysis-v1',now()) ON CONFLICT(source_system,module_key) DO NOTHING; INSERT INTO audit_action_catalog(source_system,action_code,module_key,module_name,operation_code,operation_name,operation_kind,resource_type,allow_empty_targets,enabled,version,updated_at) SELECT 'platform',action,'governance.indicator','数据指标',action,label,kind,'governance.indicator',false,true,'indicator-analysis-v1',now() FROM (VALUES ('GOV_INDICATOR_REGISTER','注册指标分析版本','UPDATE'),('GOV_INDICATOR_CALCULATE','计算指标','QUERY'),('GOV_INDICATOR_PUBLISH','发布指标版本','UPDATE')) AS actions(action,label,kind) ON CONFLICT(source_system,action_code) DO UPDATE SET module_key=EXCLUDED.module_key,module_name=EXCLUDED.module_name,operation_name=EXCLUDED.operation_name,version=EXCLUDED.version,updated_at=EXCLUDED.updated_at;
